name: @openendurance/config-ort
author: Kristopher Cargile <k@algorythmic.com>
description: Shared OSS Review Toolkit (ORT) license-compliance configuration for Open Endurance Initiative repositories.

scripts.format: pnpm exec biome format --write . && pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "**/*.{yaml,yml,md}"
scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome lint . && pnpm exec prettier --check --ignore-unknown "**/*.{yaml,yml,md}"
